import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bmi_colors = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c', 'Normal Weight': '#3498db'}
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                label=bmi, alpha=0.6, s=50, color=bmi_colors.get(bmi, '#95a5a6'))
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', loc='lower right')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Average Sleep Quality by Occupation
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = plt.cm.viridis(occupation_sleep.values / occupation_sleep.max())
bars = ax2.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlim(0, 10)
for bar, val in zip(bars, occupation_sleep.values):
    ax2.text(val + 0.1, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.1f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 3: Stress Level vs Physical Activity with Sleep Duration as color
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                      c=df['Sleep Duration'], cmap='RdYlGn', alpha=0.6, s=50)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity\n(Color: Sleep Duration)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 4: Sleep Disorder Distribution by Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Fill NaN with 'None' for visualization
df_disorder = df.copy()
df_disorder['Sleep Disorder'] = df_disorder['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_gender = pd.crosstab(df_disorder['Sleep Disorder'], df_disorder['Gender'])
disorder_gender.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#3498db', '#e91e63'], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Gender')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
